portfolios.title: Solaris Anomaly: Luxury Fragrance Spec Commercial
portfolios.description: A 30-second spec commercial for a celestial fragrance brand, tracking an iridescent glass monolith suspended in a weightless golden desert at solar eclipse.

workflow_steps.description: Explored 140+ prompt variations testing glass refraction through golden dust storms. Synthesized 4 hero keyframes with precise depth maps.
workflow_steps.parameters_snippet: prompt: 'celestial obsidian glass perfume bottle suspended over dunes, rim lighting, 35mm panavision anamorphic --ar 16:9 --style raw --v 6.0', seed: 489102

workflow_steps.description: Input keyframe image into Runway Gen-3 with custom camera pathing prompts: slow rising dolly-in with a 15-degree counter-clockwise roll.
Passed generation clips through a custom ComfyUI node pipeline to lock glass edge contrast and remove background sand flickering.
Upscaled from 1080p native render to 3840x2160 60fps with Iris LQ model to restore micro-textures in glass reflection. Mastered in ACEScc.
